title: Applicationcomponent composes Applicationcomponent
description: An application component is made up of sub-components that exist only as its parts, such as a package or directory-level component and the modules inside it.
x-dr-evidence: A directory or package modelled as a component (src/analyzers/, a Java package, a Python package with __init__.py) containing modules or subpackages modelled as components; CBM CONTAINS_FOLDER and CONTAINS_FILE.
